section.content: The invention provides a lithium ion battery. The lithium ion battery includes: the positive plate comprises a positive membrane; the negative plate comprises a negative diaphragm; and an electrolyte including an organic solvent and an additive. The coating weight of the two sides of the positive membrane is 28-56 mg/cm2Compacted density of not less than 3.5g/cm3(ii) a The double-sided coating weight of the negative electrode diaphragm is 14-28 mg/cm2Compacted density of not less than 1.4g/cm3(ii) a The organic solvent comprises linear carboxylic ester with a structure shown in a formula I; in formula I, R1、R2Each independently selected from alkyl groups of 2 to 4 carbon atoms; the mass fraction of the linear carboxylate with the structure of the formula I in the organic solvent is 5-60%; the additive comprises 1, 3-propane sultone and fluoroethylene carbonate; the mass fraction of the 1, 3-propane sultone in the electrolyte is 0.1-5%; the mass fraction of the fluoroethylene carbonate in the electrolyte is 0.1-7%. The lithium ion battery provided by the invention has the advantages of high energy density, high first coulombic efficiency, excellent rapid charging performance and excellent low-temperature charging performance.

本发明提供一种锂离子电池。所述锂离子电池包括：正极片，包括正极膜片；负极片，包括负极膜片；以及电解液，包括有机溶剂以及添加剂。所述正极膜片双面涂布重量为28～56mg/cm2，压实密度不小于3.5g/cm3；所述负极膜片双面涂布重量为14～28mg/cm2，压实密度不小于1.4g/cm3；所述有机溶剂包括式Ⅰ结构的线状羧酸酯；在式Ⅰ中，R1、R2各自独立地选自2～4个碳原子的烷基；所述式Ⅰ结构的线状羧酸酯在所述有机溶剂中的质量分数为5％～60％；所述添加剂包括1,3‑丙烷磺内酯和氟代碳酸乙烯酯；所述1,3‑丙烷磺内酯在所述电解液中的质量分数为0.1％～5％；所述氟代碳酸乙烯酯在所述电解液中的质量分数为0.1％～7％。本发明的锂离子电池同时具有高能量密度、高首次库伦效率、优良的快速充电性能和低温充电性能。

Lithium ion batteryThis application is a divisional application of the original patent application (application date is 2015, 10, 16, application number is 201510673313.8, and the name of the invention is "lithium ion battery").

Technical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a lithium ion battery.

Background

The lithium ion battery has the unique advantages of high energy density, high working voltage, low self-discharge rate, long cycle life, no pollution and the like, and is widely applied to mobile electronic products such as mobile phones, notebook computers and the like as a power source. However, with the expansion of the market demand of electronic products and the development of network technologies, users have higher requirements on lithium ion batteries, and the user experience is directly influenced by high energy density and excellent rapid charging performance.

Currently, there are several ways to improve the energy density of lithium ion batteries. (1) The positive active material of a high voltage system is developed, but the current positive active material applied to more than 4.4V is not perfect, and part of electrolyte components are not stable under the high voltage; (2) a new material with high capacity is adopted, for example, the negative electrode is doped with silicon material, but the negative electrode plate doped with the silicon material expands seriously, and the first coulomb efficiency is lower; (3) the energy density of the lithium ion battery is improved by adopting the positive and negative pole pieces with high coating weight and high compaction density, but when the positive and negative poles adopt high coating weight and high compaction density, the lithium ions are difficult to diffuse in the micropores of the electrodes, the wettability of the electrolyte is also poor, and the risk of lithium precipitation exists during low-temperature and high-rate charging. From the perspective of the electrolyte, a solvent with good wettability, low viscosity and a wider temperature window can be developed, the dynamic performance of the positive electrode and the negative electrode with high coating weight and high compaction density is improved, the concentration polarization in the charging process is reduced, the diffusion of the lithium ion battery in the electrode micropores is promoted, the low-temperature lithium precipitation risk of the lithium ion battery is inhibited, and therefore the requirements of the high energy density and the rapid charging of the lithium ion battery can be met by improving the coating weight and the compaction density of the positive electrode and the negative electrode.

Chinese patent document CN101803101B issued by 2013, 1, 9, discloses that an inhibitor for inhibiting the reaction between the negative electrode and the linear carboxylic ester needs to be added to the electrolyte, the total content of which is 0.05-10 wt%, so as to greatly improve the high-temperature discharge performance of the lithium ion battery. However, the inhibitor in the above patent is very disadvantageous to the use of the battery under high voltage conditions, especially under high temperature and high voltage conditions, because it causes an electrochemical reaction at the positive electrode in the battery system having a cut-off voltage of not less than 4.35V. Chinese patent document CN01090165A published on 12/19/2007 discloses that fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) is added as a solvent to suppress the reaction of linear carboxylic ester with a negative electrode, and the suppression mechanism is to form a thick interface film on the negative electrode by FEC. A small amount of FEC can significantly improve the normal temperature cycle performance of the lithium ion battery, but a high amount of FEC has two disadvantages: firstly, for the positive and negative electrodes with extremely high coating weight and high compaction density, the thick interfacial film can cause the battery to have serious lithium precipitation phenomenon; second, high levels of FEC decompose large amounts of HF, especially at high temperatures, which can significantly affect battery storage and high temperature cycling performance (equation i).

1, 3-Propane Sultone (PS) can also participate in the electrochemical process of the battery as an additive of the electrolyte, and the PS has the defect of reduction potential (0.7V VS Li/Li)+) The reduction potential of the cyclic carbonate is relatively close to (0.5V VS Li/Li)+) (k.xu, Chemical Reviews 2014), and thus is not suitable for use alone as a negative electrode film-forming additive.

Disclosure of Invention

In view of the problems in the background art, it is an object of the present invention to provide a lithium ion battery having high energy density, high first coulombic efficiency, excellent quick-charge performance, and low-temperature charge performance at the same time.

In order to achieve the above object, the present invention provides a lithium ion battery comprising: the positive plate comprises a positive current collector and a positive membrane which is arranged on the positive current collector and contains a positive active material, a conductive agent and a binder; the negative plate comprises a negative current collector and a negative diaphragm which is arranged on the negative current collector and contains a negative active material, a conductive agent and a binder; the isolation film is spaced between the positive and negative pole pieces; and a nonaqueous electrolytic solution including a lithium salt, a nonaqueous organic solvent, and an additive. The positive diaphragm is doubleThe weight of the top coating is not less than 28mg/cm2Compacted density of not less than 3.5g/cm3(ii) a The double-side coating weight of the negative electrode diaphragm is not less than 14mg/cm2Compacted density of not less than 1.4g/cm3(ii) a The non-aqueous organic solvent comprises linear carboxylic ester with a structure shown in a formula I; in formula I, R1、R2Each independently selected from alkyl groups of 2 to 4 carbon atoms; the additive comprises 1, 3-propane sultone and fluoroethylene carbonate.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the beneficial effects that:

the non-aqueous electrolyte provided by the invention contains the linear carboxylate compound with the structure shown in the formula I, and also contains PS and FEC. After the FEC and the PS are combined, the linear carboxylate can be matched with the linear carboxylate with the structure shown in the formula I, a stable interface film is formed on a positive electrode and a negative electrode, the chemical reaction between the linear carboxylate with the structure shown in the formula I and the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery can be avoided, the electrochemical reaction of the linear carboxylate with the structure shown in the formula I on the positive electrode can be inhibited, the dynamic performance of the positive electrode and the negative electrode with high coating weight and high compaction density can be improved, the interface impedance of the positive electrode and the negative electrode is reduced, the consumption of electrolyte is reduced, the low-temperature lithium precipitation risk of the negative electrode is reduced, the constant-current charging time of the battery is increased, the charging speed of the battery is improved, and the high-temperature storage performance and the cycle performance are improved.

Detailed Description

The lithium ion battery according to the present invention and examples, comparative examples and test procedures and test results are described below.

First, a lithium ion battery according to the present invention is explained, comprising: the positive plate comprises a positive current collector and a positive membrane which is arranged on the positive current collector and contains a positive active material, a conductive agent and a binder; the negative plate comprises a negative current collector and a negative diaphragm which is arranged on the negative current collector and contains a negative active material, a conductive agent and a binder; the isolation film is spaced between the positive and negative pole pieces; and a nonaqueous electrolyte solution comprising a lithium salt and a nonaqueous organic solventAgents and additives. The double-sided coating weight of the positive membrane is not less than 28mg/cm2Compacted density of not less than 3.5g/cm3(ii) a The double-side coating weight of the negative electrode diaphragm is not less than 14mg/cm2Compacted density of not less than 1.4g/cm3(ii) a The non-aqueous organic solvent comprises linear carboxylic ester with a structure shown in a formula I; in formula I, R1、R2Each independently selected from alkyl groups of 2 to 4 carbon atoms; the additives include 1, 3-Propane Sultone (PS) and fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC).

If the compaction density and the double-side coating weight of the anode diaphragm are too low, firstly, the lithium ion battery with the same capacity needs to use a longer anode current collector and an isolating membrane, so that the cost of the lithium ion battery is increased, and the energy density of the lithium ion battery is reduced; secondly, because the compaction density and the double-side coating weight are too low, the porosity of the anode membrane can be increased, the effective specific surface area of the anode is increased, a large amount of electrolyte is consumed for film formation, the cost of the electrolyte is increased, the transitional consumption of lithium ions in the lithium ion battery is also caused, and finally the problems of reduced first coulomb efficiency, reduced cycle life and the like are caused. If the compaction density and the double-side coating weight of the negative electrode diaphragm are too low, firstly, the lithium ion battery with the same capacity needs to use a longer negative electrode current collector and an isolating membrane, so that the cost of the lithium ion battery is increased, and the energy density of the lithium ion battery is reduced; secondly, because the compaction density and the double-side coating weight are too low, the porosity of the negative electrode diaphragm is increased, the effective specific surface area of the negative electrode is increased, a large amount of electrolyte is consumed for film formation, the cost of the electrolyte is increased, the transitional consumption of lithium ions in the lithium ion battery is caused, and finally the problems of reduced first coulombic efficiency, reduced cycle life and the like are caused; finally, the phenomenon of lithium precipitation of the negative electrode can also occur due to the fact that the compaction density and the double-sided coating weight are too low, the number of pores of the negative electrode membrane is large, the lithium ions which are embedded into the negative electrode membrane are not easy to be separated, and a large amount of lithium is accumulated to block the pores, so that the phenomenon of lithium precipitation of the negative electrode occurs.

In general, in a lithium ion battery, if the compaction density and the double-sided coating weight of an anode diaphragm are large, common electrolyte cannot be sufficiently diffused in an anode, and the thickness of the anode is large, the ohmic resistance of the anode can be increased, the migration distance of lithium ions in the anode is increased, the constant-current charging time of the battery is reduced, the charging speed of the battery is reduced, and meanwhile, because the micropore space of an electrode is small, enough electrolyte cannot be used for repairing an anode interface film, so that the cycle life of the lithium ion battery is shortened; if the compaction density and the double-side coating weight of the negative electrode diaphragm are large, the common electrolyte is not sufficiently diffused in the negative electrode, the thickness of the negative electrode is increased, the ohmic impedance of the negative electrode is increased, the migration impedance of lithium ions in the negative electrode is increased, lithium precipitation of the negative electrode is caused, and meanwhile, because the micropore space of the electrode is small, the SEI film is not repaired by enough electrolyte, and the cycle life of the lithium ion battery is shortened.

The non-aqueous electrolyte of the lithium ion battery contains the linear carboxylate with the structure shown in the formula I, and the linear carboxylate has the characteristics of low melting point, low viscosity and wide liquid range, so that the high-rate charging performance of the lithium ion battery can be effectively improved, the wettability of the electrolyte is improved, but the cyclic performance of the lithium ion battery can be seriously deteriorated due to the inevitable chemical reaction between the linear carboxylate and the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery; further, the linear carboxylic acid ester has a lower oxidation potential than the chain carbonate, and the electrochemical reaction of the linear carboxylic acid ester at the positive electrode is accelerated particularly at a high voltage. A small amount of FEC can form a thicker interfacial film on the negative electrode, inhibit the chemical reaction between the linear carboxylate with the structure shown in the formula I and the negative electrode, obviously improve the normal-temperature cycle performance of the lithium ion battery, and reduce the generation of HF by the FEC at high temperature. PS can be used as a functional additive of the electrolyte and can cooperate with FEC to form a stable SEI film on the surface of the negative electrode, so that the impedance of the SEI film of the negative electrode can be reduced, the consumption of the electrolyte can be reduced, and the storage performance and the cycle performance of the battery can be improved. Meanwhile, PS can form a passivation film on the positive electrode to inhibit the electrochemical reaction of the linear carboxylic ester with the structure shown in the formula I on the positive electrode. The PS is also easy to generate lithium sulfite (Li) at the negative electrode in the electrochemical process of the lithium ion battery2SO3) And lithium sulfonate (RSO)3Li) and can absorb a trace amount of HF generated by FEC decomposition, improving the high temperature cycle performance of the lithium ion battery. After the FEC and the PS are combined, the linear carboxylate can be matched with the linear carboxylate with the structure shown in the formula I, a stable interface film is formed on a positive electrode and a negative electrode, the chemical reaction between the linear carboxylate with the structure shown in the formula I and the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery can be avoided, the electrochemical reaction of the linear carboxylate with the structure shown in the formula I on the positive electrode can be inhibited, the dynamic performance of the positive electrode and the negative electrode with high coating weight and high compaction density can be improved, the interface impedance of the positive electrode and the negative electrode is reduced, the consumption of electrolyte is reduced, the low-temperature lithium precipitation risk of the negative electrode is reduced, the constant-current charging time of the battery is increased, the charging speed of the battery is improved, and the high-temperature storage performance and the cycle performance are improved.

In the lithium ion battery according to the invention, the linear carboxylate with the structure of formula i may be selected from one or more of Ethyl Acetate (EA), Propyl Acetate (PA), Ethyl Propionate (EP), Propyl Propionate (PP), n-Butyl Propionate (BP), and Propyl Butyrate (PB).

In the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the non-aqueous organic solvent may further include one or more of Ethylene Carbonate (EC), Propylene Carbonate (PC), dimethyl carbonate (DMC), diethyl carbonate (DEC), Ethyl Methyl Carbonate (EMC), γ -Butyrolactone (BL), and Tetrahydrofuran (THF).

In the lithium ion battery, the mass fraction of the linear carboxylate with the structure shown in the formula I in the nonaqueous organic solvent can be 5-60%. The linear carboxylate content is lower than 5%, the influence on the viscosity and the conductivity of the electrolyte is limited, and the effect of remarkably improving the high-rate charging performance and the low-temperature charging performance of the lithium ion battery cannot be achieved; if the linear carboxylate content is more than 60%, the content of cyclic carbonate having a high dielectric constant is too low, and the conductivity of the electrolyte is also lowered, which is not favorable for the quick charging performance of the lithium ion battery. Preferably, the mass fraction of the linear carboxylic ester with the structure of the formula I in the non-aqueous organic solvent is 10-40%

In the lithium ion battery, the mass fraction of the 1, 3-propane sultone in the nonaqueous electrolyte solution can be 0.1-7%. When the content of the 1, 3-propane sultone is lower than 0.1%, the effect of inhibiting the reaction of the electrolyte at the positive electrode is not enough; when the content of the 1, 3-propane sultone is higher than 7%, the impedance of the anode is increased due to too thick film formation of the anode, which is not favorable for the quick charging performance and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery. Preferably, the mass fraction of the 1, 3-propane sultone in the non-aqueous electrolyte is 3 to 5 percent

In the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the mass fraction of the fluoroethylene carbonate in the nonaqueous electrolytic solution may be 0.1% to 7%. When the content of fluoroethylene carbonate is less than 0.1%, the SEI film formed on the negative electrode is insufficient, and it is difficult to suppress the side reaction of the electrolyte on the negative electrode; when the content of fluoroethylene carbonate is higher than 7%, the formed SEI film is too thick, which causes the impedance of the negative electrode to be remarkably increased, and is not favorable for the quick charging performance and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery. Preferably, the mass fraction of the fluoroethylene carbonate in the non-aqueous electrolyte solution can be 3 to 5 percent

In the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the lithium salt may be selected from LiPF6、LiBF4、LiClO4、LiAsF6、LiN(CF3SO2)2、LiCF3SO3And one or more of LiBOB.

In the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the charge termination voltage of the lithium ion battery may be 4.35V to 5V.

In the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the positive active material may be one or more selected from lithium cobaltate, lithium manganate, lithium nickel manganese cobalt ternary material, and lithium iron phosphate.

In the lithium ion battery according to the present invention, the negative active material may be selected from graphite, silicon, or a mixture of both.

In the lithium ion battery, the coating weight of the two sides of the positive electrode membrane can be 28-56 mg/cm2The compaction density can be 3.5-4.5 g/cm3。

In the lithium ion battery, the coating weight of the two sides of the negative electrode diaphragm can be 14-28 mg/cm2Pressure ofThe solid density can be 1.4-2.0 g/cm3。

Next, comparative examples and examples of the lithium ion battery according to the present invention are explained. Wherein, the weight of the positive electrode double-sided coating is abbreviated as CW (Cathode weight); positive electrode compaction density is abbreviated cd (cathode density); the anode double-sided coating weight is abbreviated as aw (anode weight); the negative electrode compaction density is abbreviated as ad (anode density).

Comparative example 1

(1) Preparation of positive plate

1.42kg of solvent N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP), 1.2kg of binder polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) with a mass fraction of 10%, 0.16kg of conductive graphite as a conductive agent, and 7.2kg of positive electrode active material LiCoO were weighed2Fully mixing and stirring to obtain positive electrode slurry, and then uniformly coating the positive electrode slurry on a positive electrode current collector aluminum foil with the thickness of 16 mu m, wherein the coating weight of each surface is 39.0mg/cm2Then baking at 120 ℃ for 1h to obtain a positive diaphragm, and carrying out cold pressing to ensure that the compaction density of the positive diaphragm is 4.0g/cm3And then slitting to obtain the positive plate.

(2) Preparation of negative plate

Weighing 1.2kg of thickener sodium carboxymethylcellulose (CMC) solution with the mass fraction of 1.5%, 0.07kg of binder styrene-butadiene rubber emulsion with the mass fraction of 50% and 2.4kg of negative active material graphite powder, fully mixing and stirring to obtain negative electrode slurry, and then uniformly coating the negative electrode slurry on a negative electrode current collector copper foil with the thickness of 12 mu m, wherein the double-side coating weight is 19.3mg/cm respectively2Then baking the anode diaphragm for 1 hour at 120 ℃ to obtain an anode diaphragm, and carrying out cold pressing to ensure that the compacted density of the anode diaphragm is 1.6g/cm3And then slitting to obtain the negative plate.

(3) Preparation of non-aqueous electrolyte

In a drying room, weighing non-aqueous organic solvent according to the mass ratio of EC to DEC to 50:50, mixing, and adding LiPF6As a lithium salt and using LiPF6The concentration of (B) was 1mol/L, to obtain a nonaqueous electrolytic solution.

(4) Preparation of lithium ion battery

And separating the positive plate and the negative plate by using a polypropylene isolating film with the thickness of 12 mu m, winding the positive plate and the negative plate into square bare cells, then packaging the bare cells into an aluminum foil packaging bag, baking the aluminum foil packaging bag at 80 ℃ to remove water, injecting non-aqueous electrolyte, sealing, forming, exhausting and testing the capacity to obtain the finished lithium ion battery.

And finally, giving a performance test process and a test result of the lithium ion battery.

(1) First coulombic efficiency and energy density test of lithium ion battery

When the lithium ion battery is formed, the battery is charged to 3.9V at the constant current of 0.1C at the temperature of 35 ℃, and the charging capacity C is recorded01(ii) a When the first capacity test of the lithium ion battery is carried out, the battery is charged to 4.35V at the constant current of 0.2C and then charged to 0.025C at the constant voltage of 4.35V at the temperature of 35 ℃, and the charging capacity C is recorded02After standing for 10 minutes, the discharge was carried out at a constant current of 0.2C until the cut-off voltage became 3.0V, and the discharge capacity D was recorded0. First coulombic efficiency of lithium ion battery (D)0/(C01+C02)×100％。

Charging the lithium ion battery (finished lithium ion battery after formation) to 4.35V at a constant current of 1C at 25 ℃, standing for 10 minutes, and discharging at a constant current of 1C to a cut-off voltage of 3.0V (5 batteries in each group) to obtain the energy of the lithium ion battery. The energy density (Wh/L) of a lithium ion battery is the energy of the lithium ion battery/volume of the lithium ion battery.

(2) Fast charging performance test of lithium ion battery

The lithium ion cell was left to stand at 25 ℃ for 30 minutes, then discharged to 3.0V at 0.5C constant current, and left to stand for 5 minutes, after which the lithium ion cell was charged to 4.35V (5 cells per group) at 1.5C constant current, and the time required to charge to 80% depth of charge was recorded.

The depth of charge refers to the ratio of the amount of charge a lithium-ion battery receives from an external current during charging to its capacity in its fully charged state.

(3) Low temperature charging performance test of lithium ion battery

Charging the lithium ion battery to 4.35V at a constant current of 1.5C at 12 ℃ and 0 ℃ respectively, standing for 10 minutes, discharging at a constant current of 0.5C to a cut-off voltage of 3.0V, circulating for 10 weeks, then charging the lithium ion battery to 4.35V at a constant current of 1.5C, disassembling the lithium ion battery, and observing whether lithium is separated from the negative electrode interface of the lithium ion battery (5 batteries in each group). The lithium separation degree is divided into no lithium separation, slight lithium separation, medium lithium separation and serious lithium separation, wherein the slight lithium separation is that the lithium separation area of the diaphragm is less than 0.5 percent of the whole area of the diaphragm, the medium lithium separation is that the lithium separation area of the diaphragm is 0.5 to 5 percent of the whole area of the diaphragm, and the serious lithium separation is that the lithium separation area of the diaphragm is more than 5 percent of the whole area of the diaphragm.

From the performance test results of comparative examples 1 to 7 and examples 1 to 11, it can be seen that the lithium ion battery of the present invention has high first coulombic efficiency, high energy density, shorter charging time, and a lower degree of low-temperature lithium precipitation of the negative electrode.

From comparison of comparative example 1 with comparative example 4, and comparative example 2 with comparative example 3, it can be seen that the nonaqueous electrolytic solution containing only PP can improve the quick charging performance of the lithium ion battery, but is disadvantageous to the first coulombic efficiency of the lithium ion battery. From the comparison of comparative examples 4 to 6, it can be seen that neither the combination of PP + FEC nor the combination of PP + PS can simultaneously achieve high first coulombic efficiency, high energy density, shorter charging time, and the degree of low-temperature lithium deposition of the negative electrode remains serious. However, in the embodiment 5, the PP, the PS and the FEC are added simultaneously, so that the problems of first coulombic efficiency reduction, cycle life reduction and low-temperature lithium precipitation of the negative electrode caused by high coating weight and high compaction density of the positive electrode and the negative electrode are effectively solved.
